title: Shifts in soil microbiome surrounding a thermal treatment facility for hazardous waste: the hidden impact of environmentally persistent free radicals
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00439J, Paper
Open Access

Fan Zhang, Myron L. Lard, Lavrent Khachatryan, Chuqi Guo, Aiyanah Sandifer, Nora M. Villafuerte, Divine B. Nde, Robert L. Cook, Stephania A. Cormier, Jennifer Richmond-Bryant
Changes in soil microbiome near a thermal treatment facility, together with spatial variation in EPFR g-factor values, indicate higher oxygen-centered radicals near the source. Microcosm experiments show radicals differentially affect soil microbes.
